================================================================================
TEST DATA ONLY - SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - NOT A REAL PERSON
================================================================================
Every value below is invented for automated tests. Do not use any of it in a
real job application. Do not use it to populate a real candidate profile.

The name, company, dates, metrics, and URLs are fabricated. The email domain
uses .invalid, which is reserved by RFC 2606 and can never be delivered to, so
a leak of this fixture into a real application fails visibly rather than
reaching a real inbox.

Regenerating this file changes its SHA-256 and is expected: duplicate-resume
tests hash it directly and do not rely on a fixed digest.
================================================================================
